newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 30.4 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 30.4 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.5 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 30.4 billion dong ($2.7 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.5 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on February 26, the central bank issued 50 billion dong worth of one-year notes at the same rate.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is March 7, 1997, and maturity will be on March 7, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 30 billion
